reuse.why: Calls the existing ensureAccountIsNotLinked guard, link.findOrCreateBank, bankSync.syncAccount, handleSyncResponse and getServer, though the account create/upgrade body is copied because no shared link helper exists in this tree.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near-verbatim copy of linkEnableBankingAccount's create/upgrade/sync body and downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadEnableBankingTransactions, following the tree's per-provider copy pattern rather than factoring it.

placement.why: Handler, download function, server URL and provider list are each added where their siblings live; only SyncServerFintegraAccount is oddly placed in types/models/simplefin.ts.

scope.why: Only the pieces needed for a new provider on the server side are touched.

maintainability.why: Consistent with the existing providers and easy to read, but adds a sixth copy of the link flow and another copy of the transactions download that future link changes must update.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; the shared guard and bank lookup are used

disguised_duplication.where: the copies are plain copies of the enableBanking handler and download function, not disguised
